metadata.case_name: Northern Ireland / Good Friday Agreement (fragmentation prevention)
metadata.author: transcribed from live/runs by expansion agent
metadata.key_test: Tier 3 porosity inside a high-P1 sovereign; Safeguard F (economic under-delivery) divergence without return to war; Safeguard I / Mod10 (Direct Rule backstop catches every executive collapse); Mod3 (no timing claims).
metadata.notes: Run4 Case 14 -- the only prevention case. WGI cited on World Bank estimate scale (-2.5 to +2.5). UK existing-dataset P1=0.865 used for ordinal placement. Most pillar values ordinal/estimated, not cardinal.

pre_event.event_description: Good Friday Agreement: consociational power-sharing, cross-border bodies, and three-strand architecture -- textbook Tier 3 porosity inside the high-P1 UK.

context.backstop_details: UK Direct Rule: every Stormont executive collapse is caught by reversion to Direct Rule from Westminster -- the clearest single illustration of Mod10/Safeguard I (porosity-with-backstop).

data_gaps: gdp_per_capita_ppp (NI figures vary by measure: GBP25,399 GDP/cap 2024 vs GBP32,944 on a different 2023 basis)
Northern Ireland (UK).notes: Indicators are UK sovereign WGI estimates (RoL 1.27, GE 1.18). NI GDP per capita ~20% below the UK average; consistently the UK's lowest-productivity region; highest economic inactivity (26.8% vs 20.8% UK, late 2023); depends on a UK subvention of ~GBP10-11bn (about a quarter of its output). 'executive_collapses' = at least 8 Stormont suspensions covering >40% of the institution's existence.

a_trajectory_ranking.prediction: Managed instability, not collapse: executive collapses recur but are survivable; high P1 -> survival regardless of tier.
a_trajectory_ranking.basis: Tier 3 porosity inside high-P1 UK; Mod3 -- predict recurrence and survivability, NOT dates.
a_trajectory_ranking.falsification_condition: Permanent breakdown / return to war / territorial loss.

b_violence.agency_note: Mod8: predicts RISK. Prior violence legacy now de-escalated.

c_convergence.prediction: Persistent economic under-delivery / divergence (Safeguard F) -- yet no return to war.
c_convergence.basis: NI ~20% below UK GDP/cap, lowest productivity, GBP10-11bn subvention.
c_convergence.falsification_condition: Economic convergence to UK average, or divergence triggering war.

d_failure_dimension.prediction: Economic (P4) under-delivery is the binding strain, not institutional collapse.
d_failure_dimension.note: Most exposed to post-hoc coding bias.
d_failure_dimension.falsification_condition: Failure driven by a non-economic dimension.

e_fragment_count.prediction: No territorial loss; UK never permanently withdraws devolution (Mod9 not applicable).
e_fragment_count.falsification_condition: Territorial loss or permanent withdrawal of devolution.

f_reversal_risk.prediction: N/A -- not a democratic-transition reversal case.

g_suppression_mechanism.classification: Tier 3 porosity (GFA consociational power-sharing, cross-border bodies, three-strand architecture).

h_substate_turbulence.prediction: Recurrent executive (Stormont) collapses with Safeguard F economic divergence, each caught by the Direct Rule backstop (Mod10/Safeguard I). Mod3: predict recurrence + survivability, not timing.
h_substate_turbulence.falsification_condition: A collapse not caught by the backstop, leading to fragmentation.

Northern Ireland (UK).outcome_summary: Prevention worked: violence de-escalated dramatically and territorial integrity retained. Stormont suspended on at least eight occasions covering >40% of the institution's existence; every collapse caught by the UK Direct Rule backstop. Persistent Safeguard F economic divergence (~20% below UK, lowest productivity, GBP10-11bn subvention) without return to war.
key_events: Year 2000 first suspension; longest single suspension 2002-2007 (4.5 years of Direct Rule)
2017-2020 suspension; 2022-2024 suspension (DUP boycott over the Northern Ireland Protocol)
3 February 2024: power-sharing restored with Sinn Fein's Michelle O'Neill as the first nationalist First Minister, ending the two-year DUP boycott
Economic inactivity 26.8% (vs 20.8% UK) in late 2023; GBP10-11bn annual UK subvention (~quarter of output)

a_trajectory.evidence: Eight+ suspensions over >40% of the institution's life, yet power-sharing restored 3 Feb 2024 -- managed instability, survived.
a_trajectory.explanation: High-P1 sovereign produced recurrent-but-survivable collapses, exactly as predicted; Mod3 timing-agnostic framing held.

b_violence.explanation: Prior-violence legacy de-escalated without recurrence, as predicted.

analysis.overall_assessment: The framework's prevention prediction is confirmed: Tier 3 porosity inside a high-P1 sovereign produced recurrent, survivable executive collapses and de-escalated violence. The single clearest illustration of porosity-with-backstop in Run 4.
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: Tier 3 prevention porosity survives chronic executive collapse only because a hard backstop (Direct Rule) catches every failure; Mod3 discipline is essential -- predict recurrence and survivability, not when.
proposed_framework_modifications: Promote candidate Safeguard I (porosity-with-backstop) to a working safeguard.
Reaffirm Mod3 (no timing claims) for prevention cases.
analysis.baseline_impact: Promoting Safeguard I to a working safeguard needs the 20-case baseline check.
analysis.strict_recode_note: Strict re-code applied per run6 (post-hoc d-dimension -> PARTIAL; narrow-gap a-trajectory annotated with Mod4). Honest aggregate target ~62-78%.
